study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: 656 patients with a singleton gestation, ≥37 0/7 weeks gestation, and prior cesarean admitted to Labor & Delivery between 2010 and 2014
finding: A favorable admission simplified Bishop score is associated with an increased likelihood of VBAC.
mod_finding: This study investigates the likelihood of successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) and does not directly compare other modes of delivery.
